determine if there is deviation toward the side of the anomalous vein (rightward shift) and check for ipsilateral lung hypoplasia.", "On cross-sectional imaging (CT), trace the course of the anomalous vein to confirm drainage into the inferior vena cava and identify any systemic arterial supply originating from the abdominal aorta to the lower lung lobe."]}, {"category": "localization", "trigger": "When evaluating bilateral air space opacities on a chest X-ray to determine the underlying etiology based on distribution and symmetry.", "steps": ["Assess the symmetry of the opacities by comparing the left and right lung fields;
